metadata.title: On Strong Bi-Lipschitz Triviality of Deformations
metadata.abstract: The Thom-Levine theorem is a classical method for proving the triviality of deformations by integrating suitable vector fields. In this note, we show that the converse of this criterion does not hold in the bi-Lipschitz category. More precisely, we give an example of a smooth one-parameter deformation of a real function germ in two variables which is bi-Lipschitz trivial but not strongly bi-Lipschitz trivial. The central germ has an isolated critical point, though it is not finitely determined.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 给出二维实函数芽的光滑单参数变形，虽为双 Lipschitz 平凡却不是强双 Lipschitz 平凡，说明 Thom–Levine 判据的逆命题在此范畴失效。
analysis.breakthrough: 区分普通与强双 Lipschitz 平凡性，提供具体反例。
analysis.limitations: 中心函数芽有孤立临界点但不是有限决定的；不能据此推断有限决定情形同样失败。 数学解读仅依据官方摘要与作者评论，尚未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索与命中核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对度量奇点的概念边界重要，但与 Ricci 极限空间主线的联系较间接。
